meta.title: TropaTT — Free Self-Hosted CRM, Task Manager and AI Work Platform
meta.description: TropaTT is a free open-source CRM, task manager and task tracker for companies, freelancers and teams. Browser installer, shared hosting, PHP, MySQL, AI, chat, Kanban, Gantt and API.
meta.ogTitle: TropaTT — self-hosted CRM, task manager and AI work platform
meta.ogDescription: CRM, task tracking, projects, clients, chats, AI idea processing, automation and browser-based installation on PHP/MySQL.

hero.title: Self-hosted CRM without license fees
hero.subtitle: CRM, task manager, task tracker, team chat, AI idea processing, and workflow automation in your own infrastructure. Browser-based installer, MySQL, Kanban, Gantt, webhooks, modules, and REST API.

whatIs.label: At a glance
whatIs.title: What TropaTT is and why you need it
whatIs.text: TropaTT is a self-hosted work system: CRM, task manager, task tracker, project management, team chat, and AI tools in one product. It works for companies, freelancers, private teams, agencies, sales departments, operations teams, and many non-developer workflows. You install it on your own server or ordinary shared hosting, keep data under your control, and avoid cloud vendor limits or account lock-in.

helps.label: What you get
helps.title: Five things TropaTT does for you

items.title: Brings projects and tasks into one place
items.text: Instead of spreadsheets, chat threads, and scattered files — a single system. Projects with deadlines and milestones, tasks with checklists and subtasks, comments and files. All in one window.

items.title: Shows the real picture to managers
items.text: Dashboard, calendar, Kanban board, Gantt chart, and workload reports. You do not need to ask every team member what they are doing — the system shows you.

items.title: Connects clients to projects
items.text: Clients, counterparties, contacts, and a client portal in one system. Clients see project status through restricted access. You stop losing track of who owes what to whom.

items.title: Automates the routine
items.text: Recurring tasks create themselves. Approvals happen in the system, not in email. Statuses change by rules, not by memory. You spend time on work, not on administration.

items.title: Gives you the freedom to customize
items.text: Open API, module system, and full source code access. You are not locked into a proprietary platform. Integrate with anything, customize for yourself, commission modules from developers.

capabilities.label: What is inside
capabilities.title: Capabilities organized by task
capabilities.text: Not just a feature list — what you can actually do in each area.

groups.label: Projects & Tasks
groups.title: Plan, execute, control
groups.text: Create projects with milestones and deadlines, break them into tasks and subtasks, add checklists, files, and comments. Track progress on a Kanban board and Gantt chart.

groups.label: Clients
groups.title: Manage clients alongside projects
groups.text: Clients, counterparties, companies, and contacts live in the same system as projects. Clients see their project through a portal — and only theirs.

groups.label: Team
groups.title: Control access and roles
groups.text: Create users, assign roles and permissions. Root, admin, manager, member — configure access levels for your team.

groups.label: Processes
groups.title: Automate the repetitive
groups.text: Set up rules so the system creates tasks, changes statuses, sends notifications, and triggers webhooks on its own. Approvals, SLA tracking, and recurring tasks — without manual oversight.

groups.label: Extend
groups.title: Integrate and customize
groups.text: Use the REST API, webhooks, and modules to connect with external systems. Manage modules via CLI, import and export data.

ai.label: AI
ai.title: Neural networks are built in — just turn them on
ai.text: TropaTT includes AI tools for tasks, projects, clients, and ideas. A standout workflow is AI idea processing: the system asks clarifying questions, collects answers, prepares a final recommendation, and proposes a task hierarchy for CRM. AI is off by default: you choose the provider, model, and keys.
ai.statusText: AI tools are implemented in the code. They are turned off by default so you can decide which neural networks to connect and which features to activate. No mandatory AI subscription.

items.title: Works with any neural network
items.text: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and any model with an OpenAI-compatible API. Choose what fits your budget and quality requirements.

items.title: AI helps with tasks
items.text: Task summaries, breakdown into subtasks, automatic checklists, description quality checks, next-step suggestions, and comment drafts.

items.title: AI analyzes projects and clients
items.text: Project summaries, risk detection, client reports, meeting prep, data quality checks. The system highlights what you might have missed.

items.title: Searches by meaning, not keywords
items.text: Semantic search finds tasks by meaning rather than exact matches. Cannot remember the exact wording? The system finds it anyway.

items.title: 19 types of background AI jobs
items.text: Daily plans, digests, risk and data quality checks, process audits — the system watches for issues and sends reports automatically.

ideas.label: Ideas
ideas.title: Idea → AI processing → tasks
ideas.text: Got an idea? Write it down in the system. AI will run an interview: ask clarifying questions, analyze risks, assess potential, and prepare an implementation plan. After processing, the system creates tasks in CRM linked to a project — all you need to do is assign people.

steps.title: Write down the idea
steps.text: A couple lines of text is all it takes. The system accepts the idea and begins analysis.

steps.title: Answer AI questions
steps.text: The neural network asks clarifying questions about the market, competitors, resources, and risks. Your answers fuel the analysis.

steps.title: Get a full breakdown
steps.text: AI delivers an understanding card, potential score, risk report, pitfalls list, and a final recommendation.

steps.title: Tasks create themselves
steps.text: Based on the analysis, AI generates a list of tasks. Press one button — and tasks appear in CRM, linked to a new project.

features.title: AI interview
features.text: The neural network asks questions, you answer. The dialogue runs over several iterations until AI has enough data for analysis.

features.title: Understanding card
features.text: AI produces a structured summary: what the idea is, what problems it solves, who needs it.

features.title: Potential score
features.text: A numeric assessment of the idea's prospects across several dimensions: market, feasibility, risks.

features.title: Risk and pitfalls analysis
features.text: AI identifies weak spots: what could go wrong, what resources are needed, where delays are likely.

features.title: Implementation plan
features.text: A step-by-step action plan broken into phases. Each step can become a CRM task.

features.title: Automatic task creation
features.text: One button — and every step in the plan becomes a task in your project. With subtasks, checklists, and dependencies.

automation.label: Automation
automation.title: Routine runs itself
automation.text: Set up rules once — and the system creates tasks, changes statuses, sends notifications, and triggers webhooks without you.

steps.title: Event
steps.text: A task status changed, an assignee was set, a deadline approached — the system noticed.

steps.title: Rule
steps.text: You defined what to do: create a task, notify someone, trigger a webhook.

steps.title: Action
steps.text: The system executes: creates the task, sends the notification, calls the external service.

steps.title: Control
steps.text: You see in the log what triggered and what needs attention.

items.title: If-this-then-that rules
items.text: Build chains of automatic actions. Status changed → assignee set → notification sent.

items.title: Scheduled tasks
items.text: Weekly reports, monthly payments, daily checks — the system creates the task at the right time.

items.title: Deadline control
items.text: Define acceptable response and resolution times. The system warns when deadlines are at risk.

items.title: Task approval
items.text: Request approval from a manager directly in the system. No email chains or chat forwarding.

items.title: Connect external services
items.text: Send data to external systems on any event — task created, status changed, new comment added.

items.title: Extensions and limits
items.text: Limit concurrent tasks per team member. Install a ready-made module or build your own.

openSource.label: Open source
openSource.title: Your server, your code, your rules
openSource.text: TropaTT is not tied to a cloud service, requires no subscription, and does not lock you into a proprietary ecosystem. You download the code, install it on your server, and work. Security comes from the self-hosted model: data stays with you, while protection still depends on server configuration, HTTPS, access rights, updates, and backups.

items.title: Free and without SaaS limits
items.text: No per-user licensing, artificial pricing tiers, or risk of a cloud account being blocked. Real limits depend on your hosting resources and MySQL configuration.

items.title: Data on your server
items.text: Clients, tasks, files, chats, and settings live in your infrastructure. You control access, backups, and retention policies.

items.title: Open source
items.text: Inspect, modify, and extend the code yourself or with any PHP developer. The product is not hidden behind a closed SaaS layer.

items.title: OSS maintenance ready
items.text: The public repository includes README, license, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, SUPPORT, ROADMAP, CHANGELOG, issue templates, and a PR template.

items.title: Flexible customization
items.text: Add statuses, fields, workflows, reports, modules, and integrations. The system does not force a single “correct” process.

items.title: Transparent architecture
items.text: PHP 8.1+, MySQL-first storage, REST API, OpenAPI, web interface, and modular structure. Everything can be studied and adapted.

paidServices.label: Help
paidServices.title: Do not want to set it up yourself? We will help
paidServices.text: You can use TropaTT completely on your own. But if you need to get started faster, customize it, or integrate with other systems — we will do it for you.

services.title: Installation and configuration
services.text: We prepare the server, install the system, set up the database, and verify everything works. You get a ready-to-use CRM.

services.title: Business adaptation
services.text: We configure statuses, priorities, SLA, approvals, recurring tasks, and workflows to match how you actually work.

services.title: Connecting external systems
services.text: We connect TropaTT with your telephony, email, ERP, or other CRM through the API and webhooks.

services.title: Custom development
services.text: We build modules with the functionality you need, custom reports, and specific business processes.

services.title: AI activation and setup
services.text: We help you choose a neural network, connect API keys, enable AI features, and configure them for your needs.

services.title: Team training
services.text: We teach your team how to use the system — from basic operations to administration and automation setup.

paidServices.footer: Using it on your own is perfectly fine. Paid help is only for when you want to save time or get a specific customization.

items.label: Agencies & studios
items.title: Working on client projects
items.text: Managing multiple projects at once, each with its own deadlines and tasks. Clients want status visibility. You want team workload visibility. All in one system.

items.label: Internal teams
items.title: Managing tasks inside the company
items.text: IT, marketing, HR, operations — each department has its own tasks, but everyone needs tracking, assignees, and deadlines. Without buying licenses for every employee.

items.label: Business with custom processes
items.title: Standard CRMs do not fit
items.text: You tried cloud solutions, but they do not match your workflows. Here you can customize the system to fit your business — not rebuild your business to fit the system.

items.label: Integrators & developers
items.title: Building on a CRM foundation
items.text: Using TropaTT as a base: open API, module system, full source code access. Integrate, customize, build.

howItWorks.label: Installation
howItWorks.title: Browser installer for shared hosting or local setup
howItWorks.text: Upload the files, create an empty MySQL database, and open the site. If the system is not installed yet, the installer starts automatically.

steps.title: Upload the project
steps.text: Copy TropaTT files to shared hosting, a VPS, or a local host. The normal installation path does not require building the frontend.

steps.title: Create a MySQL database
steps.text: Enter host, port, database name, user, and password. The installer checks the connection before continuing.

steps.title: Complete the wizard
steps.text: Enter site URL, timezone, first administrator credentials, and confirm generated security keys.

steps.title: Get a ready system
steps.text: The installer creates .env, MySQL schema, reference data, starter data, admin user, storage directories, and an install lock file.

commands: or simply https://your-domain/ on first install
howItWorks.note: The supported database mode is MySQL. For security, use HTTPS, a strong admin password, correct file permissions, and regular backups.

items.a: Yes. You download the code, install it on your server, and use it without pricing tiers, trials, or user limits. Paid services are only for implementation, customization, or support if you choose them.

items.q: Can it run on ordinary shared hosting?
items.a: Yes, if the hosting provides PHP 8.1+, MySQL, and write access for configuration and storage directories. The browser installer prepares the database without manual SQL import.

items.q: Why is it safer than a cloud CRM?
items.a: Your data stays in your infrastructure instead of a third-party SaaS provider. Security still requires HTTPS, strong passwords, correct permissions, updates, and backups.
No. TropaTT combines CRM, task manager, task tracker, project management, team chat, calendar, Kanban, Gantt, notifications, API, modules, and AI tools.

items.q: What can AI do in TropaTT?
items.a: AI helps with tasks, projects, clients, daily and weekly plans, risk analysis, and idea processing. An idea can go through an interview, receive a recommendation, and produce tasks for CRM.

items.q: Can I integrate it with other systems?
items.a: Yes. REST API, OpenAPI, webhooks, API keys, and the module system are available for integrations.

items.q: Is the project ready for open-source participation?
items.a: The public repository includes a license, README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, SUPPORT, ROADMAP, CHANGELOG, issue templates, and a PR template. This does not claim program acceptance, but covers core open-source project expectations.

items.q: Do I have to pay for implementation or support?
items.a: No. Self-service use is a normal path. Paid help is only for faster launch, AI setup, integrations, or custom development.
